description: The project's own brand: a printed poster. Flat ink ground, paper shapes, one vermilion accent on the single focus of each frame. For the presentation videos of video-factory.
_bg: Flat ink ground: top = bottom (no gradient). Lights, close-up rays, soft shadows, dust, grain, spotlight, vignette, floor and grid are all off. light / light2 only feed derived colours: they stay on the ground colour so nothing coloured can leak.
_accent: ONE accent, vermilion, on one focus per frame. accentAlt is a neutral warm grey on purpose: this look has no second colour.
_caption: No bloom, no glow, no blurred shadow, no dark pad, no karaoke bar under the title: captions and title stand on their hard ink outline. closeY / closeBand: in a close-up the caption sits on the flat top of the host, under the collar, without the soft band.
_camera: hitFlash 0: no white flash over the frame on a punchline (the ground stays the ink).
_character: The host wears a flat mid-ink top (a tint of the ground), so the vermilion stays the one accent of the frame; flat 1 removes the shading of the head, the top and the hands.
_fonts: Space Grotesk for every label; the caption and title font of the engine (Anton) stays.
_kit: Every secondary kit colour is a tint of the paper or of the ink: no stray cyan, green, pink or violet (pink and violet would otherwise be derived from bg.light / bg.light2). Thick strokes and round corners, like the logo.
